title: Broadcast and film storyboards
dek: Storyboards and styleframes for film titles, broadcast branding and commercials, 1999–2005.
facts: Title sequences, broadcast identity and commercial storyboards
problem: Storyboards and styleframes used to pitch and plan motion work for film, television and brand clients.
approach: The boards include logo animations for Sanyo and the Sierra Club, title-sequence frames for Band of Brothers and Dracula, and a typographic sequence for Jaguar, each laid out as numbered frames showing how type and image move across a sequence.
leadership: Designed the storyboards and styleframes as part of her early motion and broadcast work.
